content: GOAL: verify cocond-markov-poincare-ot (a) behaviour x geometry coupling. READ: tree listing, train_rqvae.py (466 lines), model/model.py (50 lines), model/layers.py (296 lines). OBSERVED: layers.py is the plain Euclidean RecBole RQ-VAE port: VQLayer._distances is Euclidean squared norm (layers.py:98-104), _indices is argmin or Sinkhorn center_distance on the LAST level only (layers.py:106-113, 260-261), forward uses F.embedding + ST estimator (layers.py:131-134), init_codebook is KMeans (139-146). model.py forward/get_indices take only embeddings, no item ids, so no transition matrix can be applied. train_rqvae.py loads only item embeddings as TensorDataset (train_rqvae.py:261) with no item ids. Next: read model/utils.py and grep for any poincare/mobius/artanh/transition/markov code.

GOAL: confirm no hyperbolic/behaviour code is reachable. READ: model/utils.py (380 lines) + grep across all *.py. OBSERVED: utils.py:17-59 defines artanh/proj_to_ball/mobius_add/expmap0/logmap0/poincare_distance and utils.py:162-329 defines HVectorQuantization/HResidualVectorQuantization, but grep shows utils.py is referenced NOWHERE: model/__init__.py:3-4 imports only from .layers and .model, layers.py imports no utils, train_rqvae.py:37 does "from model import RQVAE". No hit at all for markov/transition/diffusion/B_bt/alpha-prior anywhere in the tree; the only "Sinkhorn" is the Euclidean baseline at layers.py:81-113. So both the behaviour signal and the curved operation are absent from the executed path. Next: check repo layout for result dir / launcher single-GPU branch.

RESULT (a) behaviour x geometry fidelity = NEEDS_FIX (blocking). EXERCISED PATH: train_rqvae.py:319 model(batch) -> model/model.py:27-30 encoder -> self.rq(encoded) -> model/layers.py:283-289 RQLayer loop -> layers.py:121 VQLayer.forward -> layers.py:98-104 _distances (Euclidean ||x||^2-2xc+c^2) -> layers.py:106-113 argmin, or last-level-only Sinkhorn (layers.py:260-261 makes sk active only on level 2). Exercised by static call-chain trace plus grep of all *.py: zero hits for markov/transition/diffusion/B_bt/prior-q outside comments. The only curved code is model/utils.py:17-59 (artanh/proj_to_ball/mobius_add/expmap0/logmap0/poincare_distance) and utils.py:162-329 (HVectorQuantization), and NOTHING imports model/utils.py (model/__init__.py:3-4 imports only .layers/.model). The dataset is TensorDataset(train_embeddings) at train_rqvae.py:261, i.e. embeddings only, no item ids, so a B_bt (batch x batch transition) block is not even constructible. The proposal's steps (1)-(6) are nowhere implemented.

RESULT (b) trainability = NEEDS_FIX (blocking, same root cause). EXERCISED PATH: train_rqvae.py:316-330 forward->compute_loss(train_rqvae.py:321 -> model/model.py:49-50 mse+quant_loss)->backward(324)->clip(326). The inherited path is finite and differentiable (layers.py:131-134 straight-through, layers.py:132 commitment/codebook mse), but the coupled term does not exist, so there is no behaviour-conditioned plan, no curvature parameter, no Einstein-midpoint code update, and no switch to turn behaviour/geometry off: grep finds no use_behaviour/use_curvature/alpha/q/B_bt symbol anywhere. Consequence: "both-on" is byte-identical to the Euclidean baseline; removing behaviour or replacing curvature changes nothing observable, so scope contract items 2-4 fail in code. Numeric note: utils.py:18-19 artanh clamps to +-(1-1e-10) so no inf, and utils.py:304 iterates zip(n_e_list, sk_eps) over a float -> TypeError if ever used, but the class is dead code, so minor at most, not blocking by itself.

RESULT (c) integration = NEEDS_FIX. READ: train_rqvae.py:56-67,98-107,436-466, logs/training_metrics.jsonl, logs/train_migrated.log. FINDING 1 (blocking): ARM_NAME = "TIGER_RQ-VAE" at train_rqvae.py:58 was NOT changed for this tree, so RESULT_DIR (line 59) resolves to results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/ -> OUTPUT_SID/OUTPUT_JSON/CHECKPOINT (63-65) overwrite the BASELINE arm's exports, and results/stage2_RQ-VAE/cocond-markov-poincare-ot/ is never written, so admission/Stage3 would read the wrong SIDs. Evidence: train_rqvae.py:57 comment "The arm name is this tree's promoted name; a candidate copy changes only this line"; logs/training_metrics.jsonl:3-4 writes into .../stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/. FINDING 2 (minor): LOG_DIR at train_rqvae.py:66 is REPO_ROOT/"stage2_RQ-VAE"/ARM_NAME/"logs", i.e. a stray dir outside results/. Otherwise: data path frozen (stage1 sentence_t5.npy line 61, results/stage0_build_parquet/train.parquet line 62), EPOCHS=3000 line 71, batch 1024/rank, 4-card torchrun via frozen tools.research.stage2.launcher (452-461) so the SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch stays in the framework; SID export _extend_collisions(tokens, codebook_sizes) + json keyed by embedding row index (421-427) is correctly indexed; no writes outside repo. Launcher now verified only structurally (tools/ outside the readable tree).

FINAL ANSWER (condensed record; full text printed in the reply). VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX.
a) behaviour x geometry fidelity = NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Exercised path: train_rqvae.py:319 model(batch) -> model/model.py:27-28 -> layers.py:283-289 -> layers.py:121 -> layers.py:98-104 Euclidean _distances -> layers.py:106-113 argmin / last-level-only Sinkhorn (layers.py:260-261); codebook mean at layers.py:131-146. Dataset is TensorDataset(train_embeddings) (train_rqvae.py:261) with no item ids, so a B_bt block cannot be built. Grep: no markov/transition/diffusion/B_bt/alpha/prior-q anywhere. Only curved code is model/utils.py:17-59,162-329 and nothing imports utils.py (model/__init__.py:3-4). Correction: implement Poincare cost + median-tau kernel + 3-step diffusion (row-normalise, (1-a)P+a B_bt P, column-normalise to q), argmax plan, ST log_0(c_j*) pass-through, Einstein barycenter code update, with behaviour/curvature switches.
b) trainability = NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Path train_rqvae.py:316-330 with model/model.py:49-50 and layers.py:131-134. Inherited Euclidean path is finite/differentiable, but no coupled term or switch exists (no use_behaviour/use_curvature/Einstein symbols), so both-on == baseline bit-identically and no gradient reaches a curvature parameter; the off/on comparisons are the same run.
c) integration = NEEDS_FIX. Blocking: ARM_NAME="TIGER_RQ-VAE" at train_rqvae.py:58 so RESULT_DIR (59) and OUTPUT_SID/JSON/CKPT (63-65) overwrite the baseline arm results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE instead of .../cocond-markov-poincare-ot (evidence logs/training_metrics.jsonl:3-4). Correction: set ARM_NAME to the promoted tree name. Minor: LOG_DIR at train_rqvae.py:66 is repo-root stage2_RQ-VAE/<arm>/logs, outside results/; correction: RESULT_DIR/logs. No defect: frozen data path (61-62), EPOCHS=3000, 1024/rank x4, no early stop, valid indexed SID export (195-208, 421-427), launcher delegated to frozen tools.research.stage2.launcher (452-461) with SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch left in the framework (structural check only; tools/ unreadable).
